adjudication.rationale: In Admin::GroupsController, `add_members` adds users via the domain method `group.add(user)`, but `remove_member` removes via the raw association `group.users.delete(user_id)`. In Rails, `association.delete` typically skips destroy callbacks on the join model, and it also bypasses any custom domain method (e.g., a `group.remove(user)` analogous to `group.add`). The diff doesn’t show whether Group/GroupUser has bookkeeping in callbacks or in `remove`, so the concrete impact can’t be proven here, but the add/remove asymmetry and potential callback bypass are real, diff-grounded review concerns.
